title: Area with included angle 30 degrees
source: Theory IGCSE-15.8 Quick check 1 (sides 8 and 6, area 12); new even sides
stem: Two sides of a triangle are {a|int} cm and {b|int} cm, and the included angle is \(30^\circ\). What is the area of the triangle?

steps.name: A
steps.note: A is ab/4 because sin 30 = 1/2. The engine does not evaluate a sine. Original 8 and 6 give 12.

title: Area with included angle 30 degrees, again
source: Theory IGCSE-15.8 Quick check 2 (sides 10 and 8, area 20); new even sides
stem: Two sides of a triangle are {a|int} cm and {b|int} cm, and the included angle is \(30^\circ\). What is the area of the triangle?

steps.name: A
steps.note: A is ab/4. Original 10 and 8 give 20.

title: Area with included right angle
source: Theory IGCSE-15.8 Quick check 3 (sides 7 and 8, area 28); new odd-even pairs
stem: Two sides of a triangle are {a|int} cm and {b|int} cm, and the included angle is \(90^\circ\). What is the area of the triangle?

steps.name: A
steps.note: sin 90 = 1, so A is ab/2. Original 7 and 8 give 28.

title: Find the included angle from the area

source.note: 0580/22/M/J/23 Question 17 [2]. Official QP and official MS.

stem:
This question is 0580/22/M/J/23 Question 17, taken from the official QP.

The diagram shows a triangle with an acute angle marked x°.
The area of the triangle is 2143 cm².
On the official diagram, the two sides enclosing that angle are 92.5 cm and 71 cm.

Work out the value of x. [2]

steps.name: M
steps.note: Official MS: M1 for 1/2 * 92.5 * 71 sin x = 2143 oe.

contexts.note: Stem taken from the official QP PDF (UCLES 2023), Question 17. Official MS reproduced mark by mark. Paper/self-mark.
